findings.title: GuardDuty is not enabled in eu-west-1.
Root account does not have MFA enabled.
findings.description:
Ensure MFA is enabled for the root account.

Risk: Without MFA, a leaked root password grants full control of the account.
findings.remediation:
Enable a hardware or virtual MFA device for the root user.

References: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_root-user_manage_mfa.html

findings.title: S3 Bucket example-public-assets has public access due to bucket policy.
findings.description:
Ensure there are no S3 buckets open to Everyone or Any AWS user.

Risk: Public buckets can expose sensitive data to anyone on the internet.
findings.remediation:
Ensure that the S3 bucket does not grant public access through its policy or ACL; enable S3 Block Public Access.

References: aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket example-public-assets --public-access-block-configuration BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-control-block-public-access.html
